VALUES (1001, 250.00)
ON CONFLICT (customer_id) DO UPDATE
SET balance = customer_balances.balance + EXCLUDED.balance
RETURNING balance;

text:
SELECT array_agg(tag ORDER BY tag) AS sorted_tags
FROM unnest(ARRAY['svelte', 'tauri', 'rust', 'typescript']) AS tag;
source: PostgreSQL: Array unnest and array_agg transformation

text:
SELECT 
    date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS hour_bucket,
    count(*) AS requests,
    percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p95_latency
FROM api_requests
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC;
source: PostgreSQL: Time bucketing and percentile_cont aggregation
PostgreSQL: GIN index and JSONB containment operator (@>)

text:
WITH ranked_logs AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        user_id,
        action,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) as rn
    FROM user_activity_logs
)
SELECT id, user_id, action FROM ranked_logs WHERE rn = 1;
source: PostgreSQL: Common table expression with partition window ranking

text:
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)
SELECT c.name, count(o.id) 
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id
HAVING count(o.id) > 5;
source: PostgreSQL: EXPLAIN ANALYZE with buffer cache metrics

text:
SELECT d.name AS department, e.name AS employee, e.salary
FROM departments d
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT name, salary
    FROM employees
    WHERE department_id = d.id
    ORDER BY salary DESC
    LIMIT 3
) e;
source: PostgreSQL: LATERAL subquery join for top-N items per group
PostgreSQL: Stored generated tsvector column with GIN full-text index

text:
SELECT 
    id,
    amount,
    SUM(amount) OVER (
        PARTITION BY account_id 
        ORDER BY created_at 
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_balance
FROM transactions;
source: PostgreSQL: Running total balance with window frame specification
